exposure: Gestational age category (late preterm, moderate preterm, very preterm, extreme preterm)
cohort: The study included 101 premature infants (gestational age <37 weeks) admitted to the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit at Combined Military Hospital, Gilgit, whose mothers had completed antenatal visits, between June 2017 and June 2018.
finding: The study concluded that lower gestational age is associated with greater morbidity and mortality among preterm babies.
gest_age: <37 weeks, categorized into late preterm (34-37 weeks), moderate preterm (32-<34 weeks), very preterm (28-<32 weeks), and extreme premature (<28 weeks)
